description: This file defines functions for translating JIT schema types to C++ argument types, handling argument types, and generating argument lists for structured kernels in PyTorch's code generation system.

methods.name: argumenttype_type
methods.description: Translates a Type object into a NamedCType for C++ code, handling various type cases including optional and list types.

methods.name: argument_type
methods.description: Gets the argument type for a given Argument object, considering if it is writable.

methods.name: argument
methods.description: Generates a list of Bindings for a given Argument, SelfArgument, or TensorOptionsArguments.

methods.name: impl_arguments
methods.description: Generates a list of argument Bindings for implementation functions, considering precomputed arguments.

methods.name: meta_arguments
methods.description: Generates a list of argument Bindings for meta functions.

methods.name: out_arguments
methods.description: Generates a list of argument Bindings for output arguments.
